mapper.select: select a.account_id accountId,a.id applicationId,a.status applicationStatus,a.admin_disabled adminDisabled, a.auth_epoch applicationEpoch,a.revision applicationRevision,a.system_prompt systemPrompt, u.status accountStatus,u.del_flag accountDeleted, av.id avatarVersionId,vv.id voiceVersionId,vv.voice_code providerVoiceRef, vv.official_service_id officialServiceId,vv.execution_binding voiceBinding, cast(json_unquote(json_extract(vv.official_config_snapshot,'$.revision')) as unsigned) officialServiceRevision from p_application a join sys_user u on u.user_id=a.account_id left join p_avatar avatar on avatar.id=a.avatar_id left join p_avatar_version av on av.id=avatar.current_version_id left join p_voice voice on voice.id=a.voice_id left join p_voice_version vv on vv.id=voice.current_version_id and vv.service_type='OFFICIAL' where a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.id=#{applicationId} and a.purpose='USER'

select s.id skillId,s.account_id skillAccountId,s.name,s.description,s.status,s.revision skillRevision, s.skill_type skillType,s.tool_name toolName,s.instructions,s.context_requirements contextRequirements, s.tool_url toolUrl,s.http_method httpMethod,s.input_schema inputSchema,s.output_schema outputSchema, s.tool_secret_id toolSecretId,s.requires_user_credential requiresUserCredential, s.identity_binding identityBinding,s.frontend_fields frontendFields,s.timeout_ms timeoutMs, s.max_result_bytes maxResultBytes,s.max_calls_per_session maxCallsPerSession,x.sort_order sortOrder from p_application_skill x join p_skill s on s.id=x.skill_id where x.account_id=#{accountId} and x.application_id=#{applicationId} order by x.sort_order,x.id
select a.revision applicationRevision,a.status,a.admin_disabled adminDisabled from p_application a where a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.id=#{applicationId} and a.purpose='USER' for update

select count(*) from p_resource_reference root where root.account_id=#{accountId} and root.holder_type='SESSION' and root.holder_id=#{sessionId} and root.resource_type='APPLICATION_SNAPSHOT' and root.resource_id=#{applicationId} and root.state='CONFIRMED' and not exists (select 1 from p_resource_reference r left join p_avatar_version av on r.resource_type='AVATAR_VERSION' and av.id=r.resource_id left join p_avatar avatar on avatar.id=av.avatar_id left join p_voice_version vv on r.resource_type='VOICE_VERSION' and vv.id=r.resource_id left join p_voice voice on voice.id=vv.voice_id left join p_official_service service on service.id=vv.official_service_id left join p_skill skill on r.resource_type='SKILL' and skill.id=r.resource_id where r.account_id=#{accountId} and r.holder_type='SESSION' and r.holder_id=#{sessionId} and r.state='CONFIRMED' and ( r.resource_type='AVATAR_VERSION' and (av.id is null or avatar.status not in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') or av.status!='PUBLISHED') or r.resource_type='VOICE_VERSION' and (vv.id is null or voice.status not in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') or service.status!='ACTIVE' or (vv.reference_asset_id is not null and not exists(select 1 from p_file rf where rf.id=vv.reference_asset_id and rf.purpose='VOICE_SAMPLE' and rf.status='AVAILABLE'))) or r.resource_type='SKILL' and (skill.id is null or skill.status not in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED'))))
select max_file_bytes from p_account_limit where account_id=#{accountId}
select max_sessions from p_account_limit where account_id=#{accountId} for update

select count(*) from p_application a join p_avatar avatar on avatar.id=a.avatar_id join p_avatar_version av on av.id=avatar.current_version_id join p_voice voice on voice.id=a.voice_id join p_voice_version vv on vv.id=voice.current_version_id join p_official_service official on official.id=vv.official_service_id where a.id=#{applicationId} and a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.purpose='USER' and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.admin_disabled=0 and av.status='PUBLISHED' and avatar.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and voice.visibility='OFFICIAL' and voice.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and vv.service_type='OFFICIAL' and official.capability='TTS' and official.status='ACTIVE' and not exists (select 1 from p_application_skill x join p_skill s on s.id=x.skill_id where x.application_id=a.id and s.status not in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED'))
mapper.insert: insert into p_resource_reference (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,holder_type,holder_id,operation_id,resource_type,resource_id,state,next_check_at) values (uuid_short(),utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},'SESSION',#{sessionId},#{operationId}, #{resourceType},#{resourceId},'RESERVED',date_add(utc_timestamp(3),interval 1 minute)) on duplicate key update updated_at=values(updated_at), state=if(state='RELEASED',state,'RESERVED'),operation_id=if(state='RELEASED',operation_id,values(operation_id))
mapper.update: update p_resource_reference set state='CONFIRMED',confirmed_at=utc_timestamp(3), next_check_at=null,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and holder_type='SESSION' and holder_id=#{sessionId} and operation_id=#{operationId} and state='RESERVED'

update p_resource_reference set state='RELEASED',released_at=utc_timestamp(3), next_check_at=null,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and holder_type='SESSION' and holder_id=#{sessionId} and operation_id=#{operationId} and state in ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED')
